responsibility: Declares the reachable_regions helper that computes which base regions and svalues in a region_model are reachable, and which of them are mutable through non-const access. It provides APIs for seeding traversal from regions or parameter values, iterating the discovered sets, and marking mutable reachable clusters as escaped, serving unknown-call modeling and leak detection.
same_name_distinction: Declares the reachable_regions helper, its traversal entry points, iteration APIs, and dump methods for reachability/mutability sets; unlike region-model-reachability.cc, it specifies the interface for the analysis rather than performing the recursive walk.
